description: Suijin OS v5.6.1 — installability fix release. pip install suijin works again: the 5.6.0 wheel shipped an unsatisfiable pair (rich<14 + textual>=8, which needs rich>=14.2) so every fresh install died with ResolutionImpossible; bounds are now rich>=13,<16 and textual ships in the container too. The container entrypoint no longer crashes (sys.path bootstrap before imports) and supports headless verbs (docker run image version / doctor). Blue console polish: heartbeat strip (uptime ticks, spinner never freezes), always-visible input affordance, one-line baseline training progress. The image now passes its own healthcheck (feroxbuster + john installed). Publishing is gated by a clean-venv wheel-install proof so uninstallable metadata can never ship again. 1,728 tests green.
